title: Refine Settings Routing operator UI
summary: Refine the visible Settings Routing page so height bucket edits use pixel boundary controls and routing consequences are easier to scan.
reason: The previous hierarchy improved grouping, but percent tolerance inputs and mixed target/copy columns still required too much operator interpretation.
behavior_before: The Routing builder exposed height tolerance as percent inputs in the target table and mixed target output sizes with direct-copy bitrate limits in adjacent columns.
behavior_after: The Routing builder presents boundary-height inputs as the primary height editor, visually separates encoded target sizes from direct-copy limits, and shows a routing consequence summary.
